text:
Predicates:
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
LocatedOn(x, y) ::: x is located on y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.

Premises:
Cove(barutinCove) ∧ NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ∧ Settlement(barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is a cove named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedOn(barutinCove, southwestCoastOfSnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
Island(snowIsland) ∧ Island(greenwichIsland) ∧ Island(deceptionIsland) ∧ LocatedIn(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(antarctica, southShetlandIslands) ::: Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z)) ::: If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C.

Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(barutinCove, antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
